name: Academic Adventures at FaySummer
description_short: A boarding enrichment program for students ages 10-15 on Fay School's campus in Southborough, MA. Students take three hands-on classes (Global Science, the Vox Inventum writing class and the Creators Class in design and making), join traditional camp activities each afternoon, and take off-campus trips on weekends.
activities: Creators Class (design and making with 3D printers, laser cutters and CNC routers)
refund_policy_summary: A non-refundable deposit is due when you register. If you cancel before June 1 you get a full refund minus the deposit. There are no refunds after June 1. If FaySummer cancels the program, you get a full refund. (The page gives the 2026 deadline of June 1, 2026.)
swim_waterfront_notes: There are two pools on campus. Swimming or field games are scheduled daily from 3:30 to 4:15 PM.

warnings: Prices on the page are 2026 costs: $8,400 for the 4-week program and $4,200 for each 2-week session. The page says 'Costs for 2027 will be shared soon.' Session prices were left blank because the 2027 rates have not been published.
The 2027 application is not open yet ('Stay Tuned for the 2027 Application').
The refund policy and medical-form deadline still show 2026 dates (June 1, 2026), so 2027 deadlines may be different.
financial_aid is set to true only because of a $2,000 merit scholarship for selected applicants. The page does not mention need-based aid.
Admission is by application. Applicants may need to write an essay or do an interview. Students must be fully fluent in English, and current Fay students get priority.
Airport transportation is not provided. The camp only shares a list of concierge services that families can book themselves.
